words.enDefinition: formal confirmation of a stated feature of a document

examples.en: The service desk explained which part of the letter referred to document certification.
examples.zh: 服务台说明了信里哪段说的是「文书认证」。

examples.en: The attached note described the scope of document certification beside the embossed seal.
examples.zh: 随附备注在凸纹印章旁说明了「文书认证」的范围。

words.enDefinition: formal confirmation that a copy reproduces the original document

examples.en: The clerk showed me where the copy certification appeared below the copied text.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看，「副本相符认证」写在复印文字下方的哪个位置。

examples.en: I counted three pages on the document that included the copy certification at the end.
examples.zh: 我数了一下，那份末尾有「副本相符认证」的文件一共三页。

words.enDefinition: formally state that a copy matches the original

examples.en: The phrase used to certify as a true copy appeared below a handwritten note.
examples.zh: 用于「证明副本与原件相符」的措辞写在一条手写备注下面。

examples.en: I asked which page the officer had agreed to certify as a true copy.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员答应「证明哪一页副本与原件相符」。

collocations: which page to certify as a true copy
the document you want to certify as a true copy
the photocopy they agreed to certify as a true copy

words.enDefinition: says a copy agrees with the document it reproduces

examples.en: The note says this page matches the original and refers to the copy underneath.
examples.zh: 备注说这一页「与原件相符」，指的是下面那份副本。

examples.en: I asked whether the scan matches the original after noticing a faint line near the edge.
examples.zh: 我看到边上有条淡淡的线，就问扫描件是否「与原件相符」。

collocations: verify that it matches the original
confirm that the copy matches the original
check whether it matches the original

words.enDefinition: a copy without formal confirmation that it matches the original

examples.en: I kept an uncertified copy in my folder to use when taking notes.
examples.zh: 我在文件夹里放了份「未经认证的副本」，记笔记时用。

examples.en: The file marked uncertified copy looked nearly identical to the one with the stamp.
examples.zh: 标着「未经认证的副本」的文件看起来和有盖章的那份几乎一样。

collocations: compare an uncertified copy with the original

words.enDefinition: a copy whose correspondence with the original has been certified by a notary

examples.en: The officer asked whether the attached page was a notarized copy of my statement.
examples.zh: 工作人员问，附件那一页是不是声明的「公证副本」。

examples.en: I found the notary's note at the bottom of the notarized copy in my folder.
examples.zh: 我在文件夹里那份「经公证的副本」底部找到了公证人写的备注。

words.enDefinition: a verified reproduction of selected information from a longer record

examples.en: The office sent a certified extract showing only the entry I had asked about.
examples.zh: 办事处发了一份「经认证的节录件」，只列了我问的那条记录。

examples.en: The certified extract showed the entry on its own, with a seal at the bottom.
examples.zh: 「经认证的节录件」单独列出那条记录，底部有一枚印章。

collocations: a certified extract from a register

words.enDefinition: the words used to say what has formally been confirmed

examples.en: I read the certification wording carefully because it mentioned only one side of the document.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「认证用语」，因为它只提到了文件的一面。

examples.en: The officer pointed out the certification wording between the copied text and the signature.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看复印文字和签名之间的「认证用语」。

words.enDefinition: a stamp used to mark formal confirmation on a document

examples.en: The certification stamp was faint near the edge of the page I received.
examples.zh: 我收到的那页文件边上，「认证章」的字迹很淡。

examples.en: I could see the certification stamp next to the note saying the copy was complete.
examples.zh: 我看到「认证章」就在说明副本完整的备注旁边。

words.enDefinition: an official who performs a specified certification on a document

examples.en: The certifying officer pointed to the line explaining which parts of the copy were checked.
examples.zh: 「负责认证的官员」指出了说明核对了副本哪些部分的那一行。

examples.en: I asked whether the printed title was that of the certifying officer named on the page.
examples.zh: 我问印出的职务是不是这一页写的那位「负责认证的官员」的。

collocations: a statement from the certifying officer

words.enDefinition: information identifying the person who certified a document

examples.en: The certifier's details appeared under a heading that was separate from the copied text.
examples.zh: 「认证人的资料」列在一个单独的标题下面，和复印内容分开。

examples.en: I asked whether the certifier's details on the bottom line were still readable.
examples.zh: 我问最下面一行的「认证人的资料」还能不能看清。

collocations: a box for the certifier's details

words.enDefinition: the date on which the certification was made

examples.en: The date of certification appeared in a smaller box beside the name of the reviewer.
examples.zh: 「认证日期」写在审核人姓名旁边一个较小的框里。

examples.en: I asked whether the date of certification referred to the copy or the original document.
examples.zh: 我问「认证日期」指的是副本的认证日期，还是原文件上的日期。

words.enDefinition: a seal pressed into paper so its design is raised

examples.en: The embossed seal was easy to feel but barely visible in the scanned image.
examples.zh: 「凸纹印章」摸得出来，在扫描图像里却几乎看不见。

examples.en: I asked whether the mark beside the text was an embossed seal or a printed design.
examples.zh: 我问文字旁边的标记是「凸纹印章」，还是印上去的图案。

collocations: an embossed seal on the page

words.enDefinition: an inked marking pressed onto paper by a stamp

examples.en: The ink stamp was blue and covered part of a handwritten date near the edge.
examples.zh: 「油墨印章」是蓝色的，盖住了边上手写日期的一部分。

examples.en: I noticed an ink stamp at the bottom of the copy beside the officer's title.
examples.zh: 我注意到副本底部的官员职务旁边有枚「油墨印章」。

collocations: an ink stamp on the reverse

words.enDefinition: the mark left by a seal on a document

examples.en: The seal impression was still visible where the paper had been folded over for mailing.
examples.zh: 纸张寄出时折过的地方，还能看到「印章印痕」。

examples.en: I compared the two copies because the seal impression was much clearer on the second.
examples.zh: 我把两份副本作了对照，因为第二份的「印章印痕」清楚得多。

words.enDefinition: a faint design included in paper or a document for identification

examples.en: I could see a faint watermark on the record when I moved it near the window.
examples.zh: 我把文件移到窗边时，能看到一道浅浅的「文件水印」。

examples.en: The scan kept the text clear, but the watermark was difficult to make out.
examples.zh: 扫描件的文字很清楚，但「文件水印」很难辨认。

words.enDefinition: paper made with features intended to deter copying or alteration

examples.en: The record described the original certificate as a document issued on security paper.
examples.zh: 记录说，原件证书是用「防伪纸」出具的文件。

examples.en: I asked whether the page on security paper was the one mentioned in the letter.
examples.zh: 我问用「防伪纸」印的那一页是不是信里提到的那一页。

words.enDefinition: printed information identifying an organization at the top of a letter

examples.en: The name at the top of the official letterhead matched the name in the assessment notes.
examples.zh: 「机构正式信头」顶端的名称和审核备注里的名称一致。

examples.en: I asked whether the statement on official letterhead was the same one attached to our file.
examples.zh: 我问用「机构正式信头」出具的声明是不是我们档案附的那份。

words.enDefinition: a reproduction containing all parts of the document

examples.en: I thought I had a complete copy until I noticed the printed schedule was missing.
examples.zh: 我以为自己拿的是「完整副本」，后来才发现少了印好的附表。

examples.en: The clerk labelled the pages as a complete copy, including the schedule at the end.
examples.zh: 工作人员把这些页标成「完整副本」，也包括末尾的附表。

words.enDefinition: the front and reverse surfaces of the same document

examples.en: The note referred to both sides of the document while my copy only showed the front.
examples.zh: 备注提到了「文件的正反两面」，我的副本却只有正面。

examples.en: I turned the sheet over to see whether both sides of the document carried text.
examples.zh: 我把纸翻过来，看看「文件的正反两面」是不是都有文字。

collocations: show both sides of the document
read both sides of the document
include both sides of the document

words.enDefinition: a printed copy with content reproduced on both sides of the sheet

examples.en: The double-sided copy had an annotation on the back that I'd missed at first.
examples.zh: 「双面复印件」背后有条批注，我起初没注意到。

examples.en: I checked whether the double-sided copy was the one listed on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我核对了一下，「双面复印件」是否就是回执上写的那份。

collocations: a double-sided copy of the statement

words.enDefinition: a note or requirement referring to confirmation on each page

examples.en: The notice referred to certification on every page of the copy in this case.
examples.zh: 通知提到，这一份副本需要「逐页认证」。

examples.en: I asked what certification on every page meant for the blank sheet at the end.
examples.zh: 我问「逐页认证」这句话是否也包括最后那张空白纸。

collocations: look for certification on every page
check for certification on every page
a note about certification on every page

words.enDefinition: a note saying the original can be viewed for comparison

examples.en: The copy was marked 'Original available for inspection,' with a separate note about the archive.
examples.zh: 副本上标着「原件可供查验」，另外还有一条关于档案的备注。

examples.en: I asked where the original available for inspection was kept after reading the office letter.
examples.zh: 读了办事处的信后，我问「可供查验的原件」存放在哪里。

collocations: a note saying original available for inspection
the words original available for inspection

words.enDefinition: a note indicating that the person recording it saw the original

examples.en: The clerk showed me the 'Original sighted' note at the bottom of the copy.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看副本底端的「已查验原件」备注。

examples.en: The words 'Original sighted' appeared beside the date on the sample we were reading.
examples.zh: 我们在读的样本上，日期旁写着「已查验原件」几个字。

words.enDefinition: a note indicating that the person writing it did not see the original

examples.en: The sheet was marked 'Original not seen,' and the explanation referred to a scan.
examples.zh: 那张纸标着「未见原件」，附带说明提到一份扫描件。

examples.en: I spotted 'Original not seen' above the signature on the scanned copy I received.
examples.zh: 我在收到的副本扫描件上看到，签名上面写着「未见原件」。

collocations: a note saying original not seen

words.enDefinition: says the reproduction does not include all parts of the document

examples.en: The clerk wrote that the copy is incomplete because two pages were missing from it.
examples.zh: 工作人员写道，这份「副本不完整」，因为少了两页。

examples.en: The note says the copy is incomplete and points to the last printed page.
examples.zh: 备注说这份「副本不完整」，并指明了最后一张印出的页码。

collocations: a message saying the copy is incomplete
explain why the copy is incomplete

words.enDefinition: a copy reproduced at smaller dimensions than the original

examples.en: The reduced-size copy fit on one sheet, but I couldn't read the stamp clearly.
examples.zh: 「缩小复印件」能放在一张纸上，但我看不清印章。

examples.en: I could see that it was a reduced-size copy by comparing the page margins.
examples.zh: 我对照了页边距，看出那是一份「缩小复印件」。

collocations: a reduced-size copy of the document

words.enDefinition: a marked area for the certification wording and related details

examples.en: The certification block was below the copied text and above the final page number.
examples.zh: 「认证栏」位于复印内容下方、最后一页的页码上方。

examples.en: I asked whether the certification block applied to the whole set of attached pages.
examples.zh: 我问「认证栏」是不是对应整套附页。

words.enDefinition: a stamp mark on the back of the document

examples.en: I noticed a stamp on the reverse when I removed the pages from the envelope.
examples.zh: 我从信封里抽出这些页时，注意到「背面盖的章」。

examples.en: The clerk asked me which name was written under the stamp on the reverse.
examples.zh: 工作人员问，「背面盖的章」下面写的是哪个名字。

collocations: look for a stamp on the reverse
read the stamp on the reverse
a faint stamp on the reverse

words.enDefinition: an envelope whose opening has been closed and secured

examples.en: The records office handed me a sealed envelope with the name of the department on it.
examples.zh: 档案室递给我一个「已封口的信封」，上面写了院系的名字。

examples.en: I noticed a handwritten reference on the outside of the sealed envelope that arrived yesterday.
examples.zh: 我注意到昨天送来的「已封口的信封」外面有个手写参考编号。

collocations: place a letter in a sealed envelope

words.enDefinition: a copy made at the same size as the original

examples.en: The full-size copy showed the tiny print more clearly than the smaller image in my file.
examples.zh: 「按原尺寸复制的副本」上的小字比我档案里那张缩小的图片更清楚。

examples.en: I looked at a full-size copy when the margin note was difficult to read.
examples.zh: 页边的备注难以辨认时，我查看了「按原尺寸复制的副本」。

collocations: a full-size copy of the page

words.enDefinition: a reproduction of one record contained in a register

examples.en: The archive sent a copy of an entry that listed my grandfather's former address.
examples.zh: 档案馆发了一份「登记条目的副本」，上面写了我祖父以前的地址。

examples.en: I asked how the copy of an entry differed from the short extract in my file.
examples.zh: 我问这份「登记条目的副本」和档案里的短节录有什么区别。

collocations: request a copy of an entry
read a copy of an entry
a copy of an entry in the register

words.enDefinition: a person authorized to carry out specified notarial acts

examples.en: I asked the notary public what the heading on the attached certificate meant.
examples.zh: 我问「公证人」，所附证明上的标题是什么意思。

examples.en: The notice listed a notary public as the person who signed the separate page.
examples.zh: 通知把一位「公证人」列为单独那一页的签署人。

collocations: a certificate from a notary public

words.enDefinition: the formal performance of a notarial service on a document

examples.en: I asked which page referred to notarization because the file included two separate statements.
examples.zh: 文件里有两份单独的声明，我问哪一页提到了「公证办理」。

examples.en: The receipt listed notarization as a separate item below the copying charge on my form.
examples.zh: 我的表格回执在复印费下单列了一项「公证办理」。

words.enDefinition: a particular formal action carried out by a notary

examples.en: The heading described the notarial act as an acknowledgment of the signature on the statement.
examples.zh: 标题说，这项「公证行为」是确认声明上的签名。

examples.en: I asked how the notarial act was identified in the sample we had been given.
examples.zh: 我问发给我们的样本里，怎样辨认是哪项「公证行为」。

words.enDefinition: a document recording a particular act performed by a notary

examples.en: The notarial certificate identified the act performed and referred to the attached statement.
examples.zh: 「公证证明书」列明了所作的公证行为，并提到所附的声明。

examples.en: I kept the notarial certificate with the other papers so I could identify the right copy.
examples.zh: 我把「公证证明书」和其他文件放在一起，方便辨认是哪一份副本。

words.enDefinition: the official mark used by a notary on a document

examples.en: The notarial seal appeared on the separate page underneath the account of the meeting.
examples.zh: 「公证印章」出现在单独那一页上，位于会面记录下面。

examples.en: I asked whether the faint mark at the bottom was the notarial seal.
examples.zh: 我问底部那枚淡淡的标记是不是「公证印章」。

words.enDefinition: the official appointment authorizing someone to serve as a notary

examples.en: The American sample referred to the notary commission beside the name of the officer.
examples.zh: 美国的样本在官员姓名旁提到了「公证人任命」。

examples.en: I saw the notary commission mentioned on a letter issued by the state office.
examples.zh: 我在州政府办公室签发的信里看到了「公证人任命」的表述。

collocations: a record of a notary commission

words.enDefinition: introduces the date on which the notary's appointment ends

examples.en: The sample stamp read 'My commission expires' above a handwritten date at the bottom.
examples.zh: 样本印章底部的手写日期上方写着「本人的任期到期日」。

examples.en: I noticed 'My commission expires' beside the other fields on the American notary form.
examples.zh: 我在美国公证表格的其他栏位旁看到了「本人的任期到期日」。

collocations: a field marked my commission expires
a stamp reading my commission expires

words.enDefinition: a record kept by a notary of their notarial acts

examples.en: The example showed how a notary journal was different from the certificate attached to a document.
examples.zh: 样本展示了「公证业务日志」和文件随附的公证证明书有什么区别。

examples.en: I asked what the notary journal entry referred to in the state office's example.
examples.zh: 我问州政府办公室的样例里，「公证业务日志」那一条记录指的是什么。

collocations: an entry in a notary journal
record an act in the notary journal

words.enDefinition: notarization carried out at a distance using live audio and video

examples.en: The Florida guide used remote online notarization to describe the service conducted by video.
examples.zh: 佛罗里达的指南用「远程在线公证」来描述通过视频进行的服务。

examples.en: I saw remote online notarization listed separately from appointments at the provider's office.
examples.zh: 我看到「远程在线公证」和到服务机构办公室现场办理的预约分开列出。

collocations: a record of remote online notarization
an explanation of remote online notarization

words.enDefinition: a witness with no personal stake in the matter

examples.en: The template mentioned an independent witness, and I asked what that phrase meant.
examples.zh: 模板提到了「独立见证人」，我问这个词是什么意思。

examples.en: I found a line for the independent witness under the main section of the statement.
examples.zh: 我在声明正文下面找到了「独立见证人」一栏。

collocations: a statement by an independent witness

words.enDefinition: someone permitted to witness a particular document or declaration

examples.en: The letter named the authorized witness in a box beside the declaration on my copy.
examples.zh: 这封信在我那份声明旁边的框内写明了「获授权的见证人」。

examples.en: I asked what authorized witness referred to on the Australian sample we had received.
examples.zh: 我问收到的澳大利亚样本上，「获授权的见证人」指什么。

collocations: a statement by an authorized witness

words.enDefinition: says that someone was present when an act happened

examples.en: The statement says it was signed in the presence of the person named underneath.
examples.zh: 声明写着，签署是在下方所列「那个人在场时」完成的。

examples.en: I highlighted 'In the presence of' because the words described who observed the signing.
examples.zh: 我标出了「在场时」这个说法，因为它说明了谁见证了签署。

collocations: sign in the presence of a witness
made in the presence of an officer
done in the presence of both people

words.enDefinition: a section recording that an act was witnessed and by whom

examples.en: The witnessing clause appeared below the text of the declaration on a separate line.
examples.zh: 「见证条款」在声明正文下面，单独占一行。

examples.en: I asked which person the witnessing clause identified on the final page of the document.
examples.zh: 我问文件最后一页的「见证条款」列出了哪位人员。

words.enDefinition: says the witness was present and observed the signing

examples.en: The note said 'Signed in my presence' and gave the witness's name below it.
examples.zh: 备注写着「在本人见证下签署」，下面列了见证人的名字。

examples.en: I read 'Signed in my presence' on the line directly above the embossed seal.
examples.zh: 我在凸纹印章正上方的一行读到了「在本人见证下签署」。

collocations: a note reading signed in my presence
a clause saying signed in my presence
the words signed in my presence

words.enDefinition: records that the person who signed appeared before the certifying officer

examples.en: The certificate said 'The signer appeared before me' next to the space for the date.
examples.zh: 证明的日期栏旁边写着「签署人已到本人面前」。

examples.en: I found 'The signer appeared before me' in the sample certificate below the county name.
examples.zh: 我在证明样本的县名下方看到了「签署人已到本人面前」。

collocations: a clause saying the signer appeared before me
a note reading the signer appeared before me
the words the signer appeared before me

words.enDefinition: a notarial record that a person acknowledged signing a document

examples.en: The sample notarial acknowledgment referred to the signature on the document I had read.
examples.zh: 样本的「签名确认公证」提到了我看过的那份文件上的签名。

examples.en: I asked why the notarial acknowledgment appeared on a separate page in the document packet.
examples.zh: 我问文件包里的「签名确认公证」为什么在单独一页上。

words.enDefinition: a certificate recording that someone signed and swore or affirmed a statement

examples.en: The American sample included a jurat on the last page of the sworn statement.
examples.zh: 美国样本在宣誓声明的最后一页附有「宣誓签署公证证明」。

examples.en: I asked what a jurat recorded because it had its own heading above the seal.
examples.zh: 它在印章上方有自己的标题，所以我问「宣誓签署公证证明」记录了什么。

collocations: a jurat attached to a statement

words.enDefinition: records that someone made an oath before the official writing it

examples.en: The phrase 'Sworn before me' appeared between the name and date in the certificate.
examples.zh: 证明书里的姓名和日期之间写着「在本人面前宣誓」。

examples.en: I asked who the word me referred to in the phrase sworn before me.
examples.zh: 我问「在本人面前宣誓」里的“本人”指谁。

collocations: a clause beginning sworn before me
a note reading sworn before me

words.enDefinition: records that someone signed a statement and made an oath

examples.en: The jurat used 'Subscribed and sworn' in the line above the name of the officer.
examples.zh: 宣誓签署公证证明在官员姓名上方一行使用了「已签署并宣誓」。

examples.en: I underlined 'Subscribed and sworn' while comparing the two versions of the American document.
examples.zh: 在对照这份美国文件的两个版本时，我给「已签署并宣誓」画了下划线。

collocations: a clause reading subscribed and sworn
a statement marked subscribed and sworn

words.enDefinition: make an oath that the contents of a document are true

examples.en: The officer explained what it meant to swear to the contents of the statement.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了对声明「宣誓确认内容属实」是什么意思。

examples.en: The note said the person agreed to swear to the contents of the attached document.
examples.zh: 备注说，那个人同意对所附文件「宣誓确认内容属实」。

collocations: ask someone to swear to the contents
swear to the contents of a statement
prepared to swear to the contents

words.enDefinition: make a formal promise of truthfulness

examples.en: The meeting record said the person agreed to take an oath before confirming the statement.
examples.zh: 会面记录说，那个人同意在确认声明之前「作出宣誓」。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to take an oath in the example we were reading.
examples.zh: 我问正在读的样本里，「作出宣誓」是什么意思。

collocations: take an oath before an officer
be asked to take an oath

words.enDefinition: formally receive an oath from the person making it

examples.en: The note identified the person who had agreed to administer an oath during the appointment.
examples.zh: 备注列出了同意在这次会面中「主持他人宣誓」的人。

examples.en: I asked what administer an oath meant in the description of the officer's role.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员职责说明里，「主持他人宣誓」是什么意思。

collocations: be authorized to administer an oath
ask an officer to administer an oath

words.enDefinition: a formal promise of truthfulness made without swearing an oath

examples.en: The sample showed a solemn affirmation under a heading separate from the printed oath.
examples.zh: 样本把「正式确认属实的声明」列在一个单独的标题下，和印出的誓词分开。

examples.en: I asked what the solemn affirmation referred to in the notes attached to the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格附注里，「正式确认属实的声明」指的是什么。

collocations: a statement made by solemn affirmation

words.enDefinition: a formal written statement declared to be true under applicable law

examples.en: The Australian form used 'Statutory declaration' as its heading above the first numbered section.
examples.zh: 这份澳大利亚表格在第一个编号部分上方用「法定声明」作标题。

examples.en: I asked which attachment was the statutory declaration mentioned in the letter from the office.
examples.zh: 我问哪个附件是办事处信里提到的「法定声明」。

words.enDefinition: the person making the statement in an affidavit

examples.en: The name of the deponent appeared immediately below the heading of the sworn statement.
examples.zh: 宣誓声明的标题紧下面写着「宣誓书的陈述人」姓名。

examples.en: I asked whether the deponent was the person whose words were recorded in the affidavit.
examples.zh: 我问「宣誓书的陈述人」是不是宣誓书里记录其陈述的人。

words.enDefinition: an official authorized to receive oaths in a particular jurisdiction

examples.en: The Canadian sample used commissioner for oaths as the title underneath the official's name.
examples.zh: 加拿大的样本在官员姓名下面用了「监誓员」这个职务名称。

examples.en: I asked why the letter mentioned a commissioner for oaths beside the affidavit heading.
examples.zh: 我问为什么信里在宣誓书标题旁提到「监誓员」。

collocations: a statement before a commissioner for oaths

words.enDefinition: an appointed public official whose duties vary by jurisdiction

examples.en: The New South Wales notice listed a justice of the peace for document witnessing.
examples.zh: 新南威尔士州的通知上列了一位负责文件见证的「太平绅士」。

examples.en: The justice of the peace pointed out the witness section on my Australian form.
examples.zh: 「太平绅士」指给我看了澳大利亚表格上的见证人一栏。

collocations: meet a justice of the peace
the title justice of the peace
a record witnessed by a justice of the peace

words.enDefinition: records that someone made a formal declaration before the witness

examples.en: The Australian sample included 'Declared before me' immediately above the witness's printed name.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚样本在见证人印刷体姓名正上方写着「在本人面前声明」。

examples.en: The words 'Declared before me' were followed by the town where the meeting took place.
examples.zh: 「在本人面前声明」几个字后面写了会面所在的小镇。

collocations: a line reading declared before me
a note saying declared before me

words.enDefinition: state formally that the information you give is true

examples.en: The words solemnly declare appeared at the start of the example we were reading.
examples.zh: 我们读的样本一开头就用了「郑重声明」。

examples.en: I asked what solemnly declare meant in the first sentence of the Australian form.
examples.zh: 我问澳大利亚表格第一句话里的「郑重声明」是什么意思。

collocations: solemnly declare something to be true
a statement beginning I solemnly declare

words.enDefinition: the place where a document was formally signed

examples.en: The sample showed the place of execution beside the date at the bottom.
examples.zh: 样本底部的日期旁写着「文件签署地点」。

examples.en: I asked whether the place of execution referred to the town printed in the margin.
examples.zh: 我问「文件签署地点」是不是指页边印的那座镇。

words.enDefinition: the part of a certificate identifying where the notarial act took place

examples.en: The county appeared in the notarial venue at the top of the American sample.
examples.zh: 美国样本顶端的「公证行为发生地栏」里写明了县名。

examples.en: I checked whether the city mentioned in the notes matched the notarial venue on the page.
examples.zh: 我核对了备注里提到的城市，看看是否和该页「公证行为发生地栏」一致。

collocations: a line for the notarial venue

words.enDefinition: a note indicating that a seal has been applied to something

examples.en: The note said 'Seal affixed' on the reverse, where the raised mark could be seen.
examples.zh: 备注写着背面「已盖印章」，在那里能看到凸起的印痕。

examples.en: I asked why seal affixed appeared next to the date on the separate sheet.
examples.zh: 我问为什么单独那张纸的日期旁写着「已盖印章」。

words.enDefinition: a convention certificate authenticating the origin of a public document

examples.en: The apostille appeared on a separate sheet attached to the document I was reading.
examples.zh: 我读的那份文件附了一张单独的纸，上面是「附加证明书」。

examples.en: I asked which details the apostille recorded about the signature beneath the original statement.
examples.zh: 我问「附加证明书」记录了关于原声明下方签名的哪些信息。

collocations: an apostille attached to a document

words.enDefinition: an apostille issued in electronic form

examples.en: The screen showed an e-Apostille alongside the electronic document that it referred to.
examples.zh: 屏幕上并排显示了「电子附加证明书」和它对应的电子文件。

examples.en: I asked whether the verification link belonged to the e-Apostille or the original file.
examples.zh: 我问查验链接对应的是「电子附加证明书」还是原文件。

words.enDefinition: an international convention providing for a standard form of document authentication
acceptedZhAnswers: 取消外国公文书认证要求的公约

examples.en: The booklet referred to the Apostille Convention in its section on the certificate's title.
examples.zh: 小册子介绍证书标题的章节提到了「海牙附加证明书公约」。

examples.en: I saw the name of the Apostille Convention under the form's main heading.
examples.zh: 我在表格主标题下方看到了「海牙附加证明书公约」的名称。

collocations: the text of the Apostille Convention

words.enDefinition: a body officially designated to issue apostilles for particular documents
acceptedZhAnswers: 附加证明书的主管机关

examples.en: The sample named the Competent Authority immediately below the title of the attached certificate.
examples.zh: 样本在所附证书标题的正下方写了「指定签发机关」的名称。

examples.en: I asked which name in the directory referred to the Competent Authority shown on my copy.
examples.zh: 我问目录里的哪个名称对应我这份副本上的「指定签发机关」。

collocations: a certificate from a Competent Authority

words.enDefinition: a state or jurisdiction that has agreed to be bound by a convention

examples.en: The guide used contracting party to describe a jurisdiction listed in the convention table.
examples.zh: 指南用「公约缔约方」描述公约表格上列出的一个司法管辖区。

examples.en: I asked what contracting party meant when I saw it below the convention title.
examples.zh: 我在公约标题下面看到了「公约缔约方」，就问这个词是什么意思。

collocations: a contracting party to the convention

words.enDefinition: a document treated as official under the relevant rules

examples.en: The sample described the register extract as a public document in its introductory note.
examples.zh: 样本在开头的备注里把登记节录件称为「公文书」。

examples.en: The term public document appeared beside a reference to a copy of a registry entry.
examples.zh: 「公文书」这个词出现在一条关于登记条目副本的说明旁。

collocations: the origin of a public document
a certificate linked to a public document

words.enDefinition: the particular document to which an attached certificate refers

examples.en: The certificate was attached to the underlying document in the folder I received.
examples.zh: 我收到的文件夹里，证书附在它「所对应的文书」上。

examples.en: I checked which underlying document matched the number printed on the certificate's front page.
examples.zh: 我核对了哪一份「证明书所对应的文书」和证书首页印的编号相符。

words.enDefinition: the country where someone plans to present the document

examples.en: The cover sheet asked for the intended country of use of the attached papers.
examples.zh: 封面页询问所附文件的「拟使用国家」。

examples.en: I asked what intended country of use meant in the letter from the service office.
examples.zh: 我问服务处的信里，「文件拟使用的国家」是什么意思。

collocations: state the intended country of use
ask about the intended country of use
a box for the intended country of use

words.enDefinition: indicates that a document is intended to be presented in another country

examples.en: The covering note described the attached statement as a document for use abroad.
examples.zh: 附函称，所附声明是一份「供境外使用」的文件。

examples.en: I noticed the words for use abroad next to the document title in the sample.
examples.zh: 我注意到样本的文件标题旁写着「供境外使用」。

collocations: prepare a certificate for use abroad

words.enDefinition: formal authentication of a document's origin for presentation in another country

examples.en: The British information sheet used document legalisation in the heading above the relevant section.
examples.zh: 英国的说明单在相关章节上方用了「文书境外使用认证」作标题。

examples.en: The service office filed the document legalisation notice separately from the copies of my records.
examples.zh: 服务处把「文书境外使用认证」通知与档案副本分开归档。

words.enDefinition: authentication carried out by a consular office for use in another country

examples.en: The guide discussed consular legalization in a section separate from the notarial certificate examples.
examples.zh: 指南把「领事认证」单列成一节，和公证证明书样例分开。

examples.en: I asked which stamp in the scanned file referred to consular legalization for those papers.
examples.zh: 我问扫描档案里的哪枚章指的是这些文件的「领事认证」。

words.enDefinition: a certificate confirming the origin of an official signature or seal

examples.en: The office attached an authentication certificate to the letter from the issuing agency.
examples.zh: 办事处在签发机构的信函后面附上了「文书认证书」。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the authentication certificate named the official who had signed.
examples.zh: 办事员确认「文书认证书」上是否写明了签字官员的姓名。

words.enDefinition: document authentication handled by a state authority in the United States

examples.en: The American example used state authentication to identify which office had issued the certificate.
examples.zh: 美国的样本用「州级文书认证」说明证书是哪个办公室出具的。

examples.en: I asked what state authentication meant in the note beside the printed seal.
examples.zh: 我问印着的印章旁边那条备注里，「美国州级文书认证」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: document authentication handled by a U.S. federal authority

examples.en: The sample showed federal authentication as a separate heading above the official's name.
examples.zh: 样本把「美国联邦级文书认证」作为单独标题，放在官员姓名的上方。

examples.en: I asked which line of the notice referred to federal authentication for that document.
examples.zh: 我问通知里哪一行说的是那份文件的「美国联邦级文书认证」。

words.enDefinition: officially confirm that a particular signature is genuine

examples.en: The guide used 'Authenticate a signature' to explain one part of the certificate's wording.
examples.zh: 指南用「认证签名的真实性」来解释证书措辞的一部分。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to authenticate a signature on the attached public document.
examples.zh: 我问在附上的公文书上「认证签名的真实性」是什么意思。

collocations: be asked to authenticate a signature
an authority can authenticate a signature
a certificate used to authenticate a signature

words.enDefinition: an example of a seal held for official reference

examples.en: The note mentioned a specimen seal in the office's records for the issuing body.
examples.zh: 备注提到，办公室为签发机构留存了一份「备案印章样本」。

examples.en: The checklist mentioned a specimen seal beside the entry for the agency's printed mark.
examples.zh: 清单在该机构印章的条目旁提到一份「备案印章样本」。

collocations: a record of a specimen seal

words.enDefinition: introduces the official role in which someone performed an act

examples.en: The form used 'Acting in the capacity of' before the name of the official's role.
examples.zh: 表格在官员的职务名称前用了「以某种职务身份行事」的表述。

examples.en: I read 'Acting in the capacity of' on the line immediately below the signature details.
examples.zh: 我在签名资料正下方的一行看到了「以某种职务身份行事」。

collocations: acting in the capacity of a registrar
acting in the capacity of a notary
the words acting in the capacity of

words.zhGloss: 盖有某机构或人员的章
words.enDefinition: identifies whose seal appears on a document
acceptedZhAnswers: 盖有某机构或人员的章

examples.en: The sample says the page bears the seal of the office named underneath.
examples.zh: 样本说，那一页「盖有下方所列办公室的章」。

examples.en: I noticed bears the seal of in the line describing the attached document.
examples.zh: 我注意到，描述所附文件的那行写了「盖有某机构或人员的章」。

collocations: bears the seal of the registrar
bears the seal of the issuing office
the words bears the seal of

words.enDefinition: a separate sheet joined to a document for an added certificate

examples.en: The handbook described an allonge as the separate sheet shown next to the certificate.
examples.zh: 手册把证书旁展示的那张单独的纸称为「附接文书的附页」。

examples.en: I found the certificate on an allonge at the back of the sample file.
examples.zh: 我在样本文件的背面找到了一张「附接文书的附页」，证书就在上面。

collocations: attach a certificate on an allonge
an allonge attached to a document

words.enDefinition: the identifier assigned to a particular apostille

examples.en: I compared the apostille number on the printed page with the one in the email.
examples.zh: 我把打印页上的「附加证明书编号」和邮件里的编号作了比对。

examples.en: The apostille number appeared in a small field near the end of the certificate.
examples.zh: 「附加证明书编号」在证书接近末尾的一个小栏里。

collocations: the field for an apostille number

words.enDefinition: a record of apostilles issued by a designated authority

examples.en: The guide showed where an apostille register entry appeared in the verification example.
examples.zh: 指南在查验样例里标出了「附加证明书登记册」的条目在哪里。

examples.en: I asked whether the date in the apostille register referred to the certificate's issue.
examples.zh: 我问「附加证明书登记册」里的日期是不是证书签发日期。

collocations: an entry in the apostille register

words.enDefinition: check whether an authority issued the specified apostille

examples.en: The page offered an option to verify an apostille attached to the sample statement.
examples.zh: 页面提供了「查验附加证明书」的选项，针对样本声明所附的那张。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to verify an apostille in the attached guidance notes.
examples.zh: 我问附上的说明里，「查验附加证明书」是什么意思。

collocations: a tool to verify an apostille
ask how to verify an apostille
the option to verify an apostille

words.enDefinition: the source and recorded history of a document

examples.en: The archive included information about document provenance beside the copy of the original entry.
examples.zh: 档案馆在原登记条目的副本旁附上了「文书的来源与来历」信息。

examples.en: I asked what document provenance meant on the reference sheet about the collection.
examples.zh: 我问馆藏参考说明上，「文书的来源与来历」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of authentications recorded by different authorities

examples.en: The sample described the different recorded signatures as an authentication chain on the covering sheet.
examples.zh: 样本在封面页把不同环节记录的签名描述为「逐环节认证的记录」。

examples.en: I compared the two pages to see how the authentication chain was recorded in each.
examples.zh: 我对比了两页，看看各自是怎样记载「逐环节认证的记录」的。

collocations: the authentication chain for a document

words.enDefinition: a mark recording formal confirmation of a document's origin

examples.en: The authentication stamp was printed below a line naming the official whose signature was checked.
examples.zh: 「文书来源认证章」印在一行字下面，那行字列出了签名经查验的官员。

examples.en: I could see the authentication stamp more clearly on the second scan of the document.
examples.zh: 文件第二次扫描的版本上，我能更清楚地看见「文书来源认证章」。

words.enDefinition: an examination to help establish whether something is genuine

examples.en: The letter described an authenticity check of the seal printed on the attached statement.
examples.zh: 信里说，对所附声明上印的印章做了「真伪查验」。

examples.en: I asked which field on the record referred to the authenticity check of my certificate.
examples.zh: 我问记录里哪个栏位提到我的证书的「真伪查验」。

collocations: an authenticity check on a document

words.enDefinition: an electronic mark associated with the organization issuing a digital document

examples.en: The electronic seal appeared next to the name of the issuing body in the viewer.
examples.zh: 查看器里，签发机构名称旁显示了「电子印章」。

examples.en: I asked what the electronic seal represented in the digital version of the certificate.
examples.zh: 我问证书的数字版里，「电子印章」代表什么。

collocations: a document bearing an electronic seal

words.enDefinition: agree with the details recorded in an official register

examples.en: The clerk checked that the date and reference on my copy match the registry entry.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对了我的副本日期和参考编号，确认它们「与登记记录相符」。

examples.en: The published name did not match the registry entry, so I asked about the difference.
examples.zh: 公示的名称「与登记记录不符」，所以我询问了这个差异。

collocations: check that details match the registry entry
an identifier can match the registry entry
the dates match the registry entry

words.enDefinition: an apostille issued as a physical certificate

examples.en: The folder contained a paper apostille attached to the last page of the record.
examples.zh: 文件夹里有份「纸质附加证明书」，附在记录的最后一页。

examples.en: I asked whether the picture in the email was a scan of the paper apostille.
examples.zh: 我问邮件里的图片是不是「纸质附加证明书」的扫描件。

collocations: a scan of a paper apostille

words.zhGloss: 附有附加证明书的文书
words.enDefinition: a document to which an apostille has been attached or linked
acceptedZhAnswers: 附有附加证明书的文书

examples.en: The office returned the apostilled document in the same envelope as my other records.
examples.zh: 办事处用装我其他档案的同一个信封退回了「附有附加证明书的文书」。

examples.en: I asked whether the attachment showed the entire apostilled document or just the certificate.
examples.zh: 我问附件显示的是整份「附有附加证明书的文书」，还是只有证明书。

collocations: a copy of an apostilled document

words.enDefinition: an electronic link to a page that can verify a record

examples.en: The verification link led to a page showing the certificate number from my copy.
examples.zh: 「查验链接」打开的是一个显示我那份副本上证书编号的页面。

examples.en: I asked whether the verification link in the notice was for the attached certificate.
examples.zh: 我问通知里的「查验链接」是不是对应所附证书。

collocations: a verification link for a certificate

words.enDefinition: the official who formally issues a particular document or certificate

examples.en: The issuing official was named on the line below the date of the certificate.
examples.zh: 证书日期的下一行列了「签发文件的官员」的姓名。

examples.en: I checked whether the title on the attached sheet referred to the same issuing official.
examples.zh: 我确认附页上的职务是否指同一位「签发文件的官员」。

collocations: a signature from the issuing official

words.enDefinition: a translator with a credential recognized by a professional body or authority

examples.en: The Canadian guidance referred to a certified translator beside its examples of translation stamps.
examples.zh: 加拿大的指南在译员印章示例旁提到了「持认证资质的译员」。

examples.en: I read the note from the certified translator before comparing the two versions of the document.
examples.zh: 我先读了「持认证资质的译员」的备注，再对照文件的两个版本。

collocations: a translation by a certified translator

words.enDefinition: a translator formally sworn or appointed under a local system

examples.en: The French guidance used sworn translator in its explanation of the local translation service.
examples.zh: 法国指南在介绍当地翻译服务时用了「宣誓译员」。

examples.en: The seal on my translation identified a sworn translator and showed the language pair.
examples.zh: 我那份译文上的印章列出了一位「宣誓译员」，还注明了翻译的语种组合。

collocations: a document translated by a sworn translator

words.enDefinition: a translator holding an Australian NAATI translation credential

examples.en: The Australian form referred to a NAATI-certified translator in the section about language services.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚表格在语言服务一栏提到了「澳大利亚NAATI认证译员」。

examples.en: I compared the name of the NAATI-certified translator with the name printed on the stamp.
examples.zh: 我核对了「澳大利亚NAATI认证译员」姓名和印章上印的姓名。

collocations: a statement from a NAATI-certified translator
a translation by a NAATI-certified translator

words.enDefinition: a stamp displaying a translator's NAATI credential information

examples.en: The NAATI stamp appeared at the bottom of the Australian translation beside the date.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚翻译件底部的日期旁边有「澳大利亚NAATI译员印章」。

examples.en: I enlarged the page because the smaller text on the NAATI stamp was hard to read.
examples.zh: 我放大了这一页，因为「澳大利亚NAATI译员印章」上的小字很难看清。

words.enDefinition: the identifier NAATI assigns to a certified language professional

examples.en: The Australian directory calls the identifier under the translator's name a Certified Practitioner Number.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的名录把译员姓名下方的识别号码称为「认证从业人员编号」。

examples.en: I compared the Certified Practitioner Number on the stamp with the entry shown on screen.
examples.zh: 我把章上的「认证从业人员编号」和屏幕显示的条目作了比对。

collocations: a field for the Certified Practitioner Number

words.enDefinition: a translator's written statement about the accuracy of a translation

examples.en: The translator's declaration was attached as a final page after the translated text.
examples.zh: 「译员声明」放在译文后面，作为最后一页。

examples.en: I checked whether the translator's declaration referred to all three documents in my folder.
examples.zh: 我核对了「译员声明」是否涵盖我文件夹里的三份文件。

words.enDefinition: a statement sworn by a translator about the accuracy of a translation

examples.en: The Canadian example had a translator's affidavit on a different page from the translated record.
examples.zh: 在加拿大的样例里，「译员宣誓书」和译好的记录分开排在不同的页。

examples.en: The clerk pointed out the translator's affidavit while referring to the separate witnessing statement.
examples.zh: 工作人员在提到单独的见证声明时，指出了「译员宣誓书」的位置。

collocations: a translator's affidavit attached to a translation

words.enDefinition: a translation accompanied by a notarial act, often concerning the translator's signature

examples.en: The packet contained a notarized translation with a separate certificate about the translator's signature.
examples.zh: 文件包里有一份「附有公证的译文」，另有关于译员签名的证明书。

examples.en: I asked which part of the notarized translation the notarial certificate referred to.
examples.zh: 我问公证证明书指的是「附有公证的译文」里的哪一部分。

collocations: request information about a notarized translation
a notarized translation of the statement

words.enDefinition: a business that arranges or provides translation services

examples.en: The translation agency sent a separate note explaining how it had written the place names.
examples.zh: 「翻译机构」另发了一份备注，说明地名是怎么写的。

examples.en: I contacted the translation agency when I noticed a sentence missing from the final page.
examples.zh: 我发现最后一页少了一句话，就联系了「翻译机构」。

collocations: a letter from a translation agency

words.enDefinition: a translation that correctly reproduces the meaning of the original

examples.en: The declaration described the attached English version as a true and accurate translation.
examples.zh: 声明把所附英文版描述为一份「忠实准确的译文」。

examples.en: I saw 'A true and accurate translation' in the statement printed above the signature.
examples.zh: 我在签名上方印着的声明里看到了「忠实准确的译文」。

collocations: confirm a true and accurate translation
a statement saying a true and accurate translation
describe it as a true and accurate translation

words.enDefinition: a translation covering the entire text of the original

examples.en: The complete translation included the small line of text at the bottom of the receipt.
examples.zh: 「完整译文」连回执底部那行小字也译了。

examples.en: I compared the complete translation with the earlier version that had ended after two pages.
examples.zh: 我把「完整译文」和之前只到第二页的版本作了对照。

collocations: compare a complete translation with the source

words.enDefinition: a translation of only part of a source text

examples.en: The file name described it as a partial translation covering only the handwritten note.
examples.zh: 文件名说明这是「部分译文」，只译了手写备注。

examples.en: I used a partial translation to understand the heading before reading the whole document.
examples.zh: 我用「部分译文」弄懂标题，再读整份文件。

words.enDefinition: a translation produced without formal certification or official issue

examples.en: I made an unofficial translation to understand what the notice said about my appointment.
examples.zh: 我自己翻译了一份「未经正式认证的译文」，好理解通知里关于预约的内容。

examples.en: The page called the English text an unofficial translation of the short letter attached.
examples.zh: 该页把英语文本称为所附短信的「未经正式认证的译文」。

words.enDefinition: the date recorded for the completion or issue of a translation

examples.en: The translation date appeared below the language pair on the cover sheet from the agency.
examples.zh: 「翻译日期」在翻译机构提供的封面页上，位于语种组合下方。

examples.en: I compared the translation date with the older date shown on the original document.
examples.zh: 我把「翻译日期」和原件上更早的日期作了对照。

collocations: the field for the translation date

words.enDefinition: the signature by which the translator signs the translated record or statement

examples.en: I found the translator's signature below the statement describing the scope of the work.
examples.zh: 我在说明翻译范围的声明下面找到了「译员签名」。

examples.en: The translator's signature appeared next to an ink stamp at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 页底的油墨印章旁边有「译员签名」。

collocations: a page bearing the translator's signature

words.enDefinition: information for reaching the person who made the translation

examples.en: The translator's contact details were printed beside the date on the final page.
examples.zh: 「译员联系资料」印在最后一页的日期旁边。

examples.en: I checked whether the translator's contact details were visible in the file I received.
examples.zh: 我查了收到的文件里能不能看清「译员联系资料」。

collocations: a line for the translator's contact details

words.enDefinition: the two languages involved in a translation assignment

examples.en: The translator listed the language pair below the heading on the first page.
examples.zh: 译员在第一页标题下面列了「翻译语种组合」。

examples.en: I asked whether the language pair on the stamp referred to this particular translation.
examples.zh: 我问印章上的「语种组合」是不是指这份翻译。

collocations: work with a particular language pair

words.enDefinition: the language in which the text being translated was written

examples.en: The translator identified the source language next to the title of the original statement.
examples.zh: 译员在原声明标题旁边注明了「源语」。

examples.en: I checked which source language the note referred to because the document was bilingual.
examples.zh: 文件用了两种语言，我就核对了备注里指的是哪一种「源语」。

collocations: a document in the source language

words.enDefinition: the language into which the text is translated

examples.en: The target language was printed beside the name of the translation agency on my copy.
examples.zh: 我那份副本上，「目标语」印在翻译机构名称旁边。

examples.en: I checked which target language was listed before comparing the two attachments in my email.
examples.zh: 对照邮件里的两个附件前，我查了列出的是哪种「目标语」。

words.enDefinition: the version of the document in the language first used

examples.en: The file included an original-language version as well as the English text on another page.
examples.zh: 文件里有「原文语种版本」，另一页还有英文版。

examples.en: I referred to the original-language version to see how the town's name was written.
examples.zh: 我看了「原文语种版本」，确认小镇的名字怎么写。

collocations: compare the original-language version with the translation

words.enDefinition: an explanation added by the translator about a specific detail

examples.en: A translator's note explained why part of the official mark was shown in brackets.
examples.zh: 「译者注」解释了为什么官方标记的一部分写在括号里。

examples.en: I found a translator's note beside the name that was spelled two different ways.
examples.zh: 我在那个有两种拼法的名字旁边发现了一条「译者注」。

words.enDefinition: representing text from one writing system in the characters of another

examples.en: The transliteration of my name appeared next to its original characters on the translation.
examples.zh: 译文里的「姓名转写」和原来的汉字写在一起。

examples.en: I compared the transliteration with the spelling I usually use for my name abroad.
examples.zh: 我把「文字转写」和自己在国外通常用的姓名拼法作了比对。

words.enDefinition: a written form expressed in the Latin alphabet

examples.en: The Romanized spelling was different on two documents, so I asked about the difference.
examples.zh: 两份文件上的「罗马字母拼写」不同，我就问了这个差异。

examples.en: I compared the Romanized spelling with the characters shown in the left column.
examples.zh: 我把「罗马字母拼写」和左栏里的原文字作了比对。

collocations: the Romanized spelling of a name

words.enDefinition: an original seal whose wording is absent from the translated version

examples.en: I noticed an untranslated seal beside the date and asked about its wording.
examples.zh: 我发现日期旁边有个「未翻译文字的印章」，就问它写的是什么。

examples.en: The review listed the untranslated seal separately from the other text in the attachment.
examples.zh: 审核记录把「未翻译文字的印章」和附件里的其他文字分开列了。

collocations: a comment about an untranslated seal

words.enDefinition: a stamped marking too unclear for its wording to be read

examples.en: The translator added a note about the illegible stamp at the bottom of the scan.
examples.zh: 译员对扫描页底部「字迹难辨的印章」加了一条注释。

examples.en: I found another image of the page with the illegible stamp in my old files.
examples.zh: 我在旧文件里找到了有那枚「字迹难辨的印章」的另一张页面图片。

collocations: a note about an illegible stamp

words.enDefinition: source wording that was left out of the translation

examples.en: The omitted text was a label printed beside the stamp on the original document.
examples.zh: 「漏译的文字」是原件印章旁边一个印出来的标签。

examples.en: I marked the omitted text after comparing the translation with my copy of the original.
examples.zh: 我把翻译件和原件副本对照后，标出了「漏译的文字」。

words.enDefinition: an additional translation provided for material not covered earlier

examples.en: The supplementary translation covered the handwritten note that was not in the first version.
examples.zh: 「补充译文」译了第一版里没译的手写备注。

examples.en: I received a supplementary translation for the stamp on the reverse of the document.
examples.zh: 文件背面的印章，我收到了一份「补充译文」。

words.enDefinition: a revised version addressing errors in an earlier translation

examples.en: The corrected translation showed the revised name spelling on the first page of the record.
examples.zh: 「更正后的译文」在记录的第一页写了改过的姓名拼法。

examples.en: I compared the corrected translation with the earlier version before sending my reply to the office.
examples.zh: 我把「更正后的译文」和先前的版本作了比较，然后回复办事处。

collocations: a corrected translation of the record

words.enDefinition: a document containing text in two languages

examples.en: The bilingual document placed the two versions of the statement in separate columns.
examples.zh: 「双语文件」把这份声明的两个语言版本放在不同的栏里。

examples.en: I checked both headings on the bilingual document before asking which version to read.
examples.zh: 我看了「双语文件」里的两个标题，再问该读哪个版本。

collocations: a bilingual document with two columns
a section of a bilingual document
